batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c LR Shukla b AB Dinda

balls.text: much fuller, again looking for the yorker, Dhoni tries one of those paddle shots to fine leg but cannot connect, the result of his expansive efforts is a leg bye to the off side
bad, bad bad Agarkar! Over a decade of international cricket and he's bowling this trash ... very wide outside off stump, Dhoni jumps across to hit it but cannot reach there
now he miscues one and scoops the full ball over cover, was planning on slamming that much straighter but survives as the ball lands safely in the deep
good ball, but an even better shot! Agarkar nails the yorker just outside off stump but Albie is in sublime form, just opening the face and squeezing it superbly past gully
ooh thats a shot! Agarkar hits a length, Albie clears the leg and tees off for a massive straight six, that was just in the slot and he didn't disappoint at all
wow thats flat, has to be the flattest we've seen so far this IPL! Short of a length on the stumps and before you can say hello dolly Albie flat-bats it over square leg
well bowled, Ajit! Yorker outside off stump slides under the bat
good ball to end the over, on a length, the wrong 'un again, and defended
swings at one looped up on the stumps and gets an inside edge to leg

chance gone down! Dhoni charges down, Mendis keeps it short and wide, Dhoni slaps at the ball and gets a top edge that pops up toward third man, where Kartik doesn't step forward and instead falls over and doesn't even get there at all ... his second drop of the evening
offbreak this time, slower and on a length, Dhoni pushes to extra cover
take that! What a fierce shot from Dhoni, skipping out to collect on the full and absolutely smashes that over mid-on and the man in the deep hadn't a chance to stop it
good ball, the sliding wrong'un, pitches well outside leg stump and hits the pad as Albie goes back to cut, scampers a single even as Mendis appeals
too full on the pads and Dhoni flicks it wide of short fine leg
pitches it up on middle and leg and Albie drives down to long-off
slower ball goes awry, pitches well outside leg stump
bouncer over leg stump, Albie flinches, good ball at this stage of the innings
good ball, yorker right on off stump and well dug out to the covers
full on the pads and he flicks it out to deep midwicket to open his score
short outside off stump and he slices off the back foot past cover
wide ball, what are you doing? Pitches it well outside off stump
gone to a full toss of all things! Dinda slips out a wide full toss, Raina slogs and gets a thick outside edge that spirals up and settles right in backward point's hands
but that will erase the dot ball and raise Raina's half-century! Short ball outside off stump and he pulls it very well for a big six over midwicket, well played Raina
slower ball again, this time he pitches it up and Raina slogs wildly, unable to connect on that delivery, so a crucial dot ball goes Kolkata's way
slower short ball, change of pace nearly beats Dhoni who pulls and gets an inside edge wide of square leg
serves up a low full toss outside off stump, looking for the yorker, and Dhoni slices it with a thin outside edge that flies wide of backward point and beats third man
good ball, full outside off, Raina clears the front leg and swings to long-on
back of a length just outside off and he calmly punches it to long-off
the wrong 'un, pitches on a length and Dhoni drives to extra cover
flat on the pads, Dhoni skips out and flicks wide of the man for a couple
short again, Raina rocks back and pulls over the infield to the sweeper
make that two in two, just getting under a full ball and scooping it over mid-on, a mistimed flick but he's got enough bat on it
length ball on the stumps and he smashes it over midwicket very flat
good ball, the yorker outside off stump, beats Dhoni's bat as well
makes some room, exposing all the sticks, and smashes a full ball back past Dhoni down to Hussey running across near long-off
tries the bouncer over leg stump, Raina flinches, not called a wide
much fuller and Raina drives hard to mid-off and gets sent back quickly
short of a length on the stumps, Raina too is cramped and defends
pitches it up and slants it in to cramp Dhoni, who pushes to extra cover
full outside off stump and Dhoni hits it hard down to long-off for one
good shot, punching the length ball on the rise through cover
attempted bouncer over leg stump, Raina ducks and a wide is called
pitches fuller and Dhoni pushes it back for a single

another drop and this one was a doozie! Agarkar bends his back and produces a good short ball that gains on Dhoni, who pulls but takes it high on the splice, spooning an easy catch to Kartik at midwicket but he jogs back to his right and fluffs it
fuller ball and eases it straight to the off side fielder

a drop but that would have taken some stopping honestly! Short ball, Dhoni flat-bats that ferociously back to Agarkar, who starts to go for it but then does well to get out of harm's way because that ball would have sliced his ear off it was hit so hard
flat on the stumps and he presses forward to play it watchfully
spins flat and wide of the stumps for an extra run to the score
arm ball, just outside off stump, punched away toward cover for one, a dribble of a throw comes back and Raina gets one more after Hussey fails to collect it cleanly
speared into the pads, Raina clips it wide of mid-on, runs hard, the fielding in the deep is a bit slow and Raina runs back for the second easily
now he goes for a reverse sweep to a flatter ball and gets a single
big shot from Dhoni, reaching out and clubbing the length ball from outside off stump, connects really well and goes high over long-off for half a dozen
flat on middle and leg and Raina drives handsomely past mid-off
overpitched outside off stump, Raina steers it into the gap at point for one
starts to come out, Kartik fires it in but Dhoni still on-drives a single
flatter down the pads and he tucks away a single
short and he gets right over the ball, using the wrists to cut it behind square on the off side, beats the man in front and out in the deep on a very fast outfield
flat on middle and off, Raina gets in line and defends it back
slow ball down the pads, easy pickings for Dhoni, who turns it fine
errs in length and Raina flat-bats the short ball over midwicket's leap
back to short and wide and this one's cut out to the sweeper
slower, fuller, Dhoni reaches out plays it back to Mendis
too short and Dhoni cuts off the back foot but picks out cover
slower ball, offbreak, pitched up and Raina drives to extra cover
slow offcutter on a very good length and Dhoni drives it to extra cover
short and wide, he cuts and misses and no reaction from the umpire
a tad short and he gets back to punch but cannot beat cover or point
flat on the pads and he clips the ball wide of the man inside
a loose shot there, Raina reaches out to a wide ball and scoops it just over cover's fingertips, the ball didn't come on as he expected and he's lucky
flat outside off stump and he punches down to mid-off and sets off

slow ball, flighted well up on off stump, Raina gets over it to smother the turn, the ball rolls toward point and they set off, Raina makes it easily but Bailey is struggling and dives full stretch but the fielder doesn't have to do much except nail a good flat throw and Bailey's dive is in vain ... truth be told, that wasn't a good run because the ball went right to the man at point
tries to go downtown but mistimes the shot, the ball goes in the air wide of mid-off and dribbles down to the man running in from long-off
pushes it through flatter and quicker and Raina pushes to cover
down he comes to try and swing the flat ball away, doesn't get much on it but goes over square leg and gets a single for his efforts
too short and he goes back to cut into the gap at cover and point
flat just outside off stump, Raina comes forward and defends
slowly tossed up on middle and off and turns it wide of midwicket
full and straight, no turn at all, Bailey uses his feet to clip to midwicket
slower ball looped up on the pads, Raina cocks the wrists and gets one
too full and straight so Bailey tucks it off his pads for a single
fuller, middle and off, turns away and Raina pushes it to cover
pitches short and goes away, Bailey gets across and flicks it away
straight ball on a length and Bailey shuffles to pick the gap at midwicket
super shot, just gently opens the face as he pushes forward to a loopy delivery outside off stump, connects well and rather deftly to get four well wide of short third man
slower ball drifts into middle and leg, Bailey drives easily to mid-off
too short and he gets back to punch it back past Kartik to long-on
uses his feet to the spinner, and does so well, pushing to extra cover
flat outside off, just a tad wide and Raina pinches one wide of point

loose running, a good throw, and Patel has to go! Better ball, flatter on middle and leg, Bailey turns it wide of square leg and sets off, Patel reaches out to ground his bat home as the throw comes in from Shukla, its a direct hit and replays show he was a few inches short
slow ball drifts down the pads, Bailey sweeps and misses, just, and the ball goes on wide of the wicketkeeper for four wides
flatter ball turns into Patel and he backs away and works it off his pads
just a bit too wide and Patel pounces on the short ball with a firm cut
fuller ball, not as slow, pitches just outside off and turns away sharply, Patel swings and misses
starts to come out to the slower ball and pushes it wide of cover
flatter ball down the pads and he sweeps and runs very hard
tosses it up generously, pitches on a length, Patel has a big swing but misses, the wicketkeeper also misses it and thats four byes, oh that was so close
a tad shorter, no turn, Patel mistimes the paddle pull to short fine leg where Anureet fumbles the collection so they get a single in the end
fast and flat and straight and he skips out to drive hard to mid-on
beats him with a faster one outside off, Patel pushes at it and the ball doesn't turn, looks like the arm ball that just went on straight
jumps out of his crease, Kartik keeps it flat down the stumps, Bailey adjusts and flicks an inside edge to short fine leg, Patel wants one and runs hard to get it
flights it on a length, off stump, flicked across the line to midwicket
low full toss outside off stump, a freebie, slapped back past mid-on
pitches it up outside off and Patel pushes to the off side and sets off
short on leg stump, attempted slower ball, Patel pulls it but doesn't connect well and the ball just dribbles to the man at square leg, he really missed out there
hops well outside off stump and tries to tuck the ball away, its too full for that shot and he gets struck on the pads well outside the line of impact, scampers a leg bye
gets across his stumps and tucks the length ball to midwicket
pitches it on a length, Bailey makes room and charges, hitting the ball in the air over extra cover for four, aggressive shot that from him
bangs it short outside off and Patel pulls it just wide of midwicket
short and way down the leg side, poor ball from Agarkar to start off
low full toss on the stumps but he flicks it to the man at square leg
shuffles across his stumps again, flicking the full ball into the space wide of square leg, getting deep fine leg into play
short outside off stump this time and Bailey waits before rolling the wrists and back-cutting the ball behind backward point, third man cannot get there in time
bang thats four! Connects well on the pull shot, smacking the short ball over midwicket for four, got into position early
walks across the stumps before the ball is bowled, its short and slanting over the top of leg stump and Bailey cannot connect on the attempted pull shot
pitches it up, Bailey drives it back and Dinda dives to stop the ball
bad ball with fine leg up in the circle, serves it up down the pads and Patel glances it very fine to end the over with a boundary
full and wide again, slants even wider and umpire Tiffen has work to do
short of a length, jags back into off stump, Bailey hops across and turns the ball wide of midwicket for another quick single
change of pace, length ball outside off stump, Patel pushes it down in front of mid-off and sets off for the risky run, McCullum collects and throws but misses
short of a length just outside off, Patel thinks about turning the wrists and working the ball to the leg side but then adjusts to defend the ball back to Anureet
too wide that outside off stump, Patel leaves and wide is called
pitched up on middle and off and he drives it back to the bowler
and thats a good shot to a half-volley on off stump, just gets there and punches it back past the stumps and mid-off for four, easy as they come for Patel
fullish, probing him outside off, he handles it well, gets to the pitch and defends it towards cover
back of a length on the off, pushes it firmly towards mid-off
he's away, lands it short on middle, rocks back and whips it away through square leg for a boundary
length ball on the off, gets forward and defends it towards cover
slightly short on the off, pushed to cover off the back foot
a touch fortunate straightaway, back of a length outside off from Dinda, left him a bit, prodded at it, got a thick outside edge to third man

thats it, an incredible win for Kolkata, and one richly deserved after the season they've had! Raina keeps it wide, Saha chases and loosely chips it over the covers but its all safe because there is no one out there and Kolkata win by seven wickets
short on the stumps, biffed down to long-on, they really hustle, Oram runs around and throws it back and the scores are tied

run out chance missed! Raina keeps it a tad short, Hodge hits it to extra cover and absolutely bolts out of the stables, Dhoni runs in and fields and throws the ball to Raina who isn't behind the stumps but anyways Hodge looked inside
flatter, wider, Saha reaches out and slogs right to midwicket
slower ball again, on a length, Hodge slogs from his crease and gets an inside edge wide of short fine leg down to the sweeper for a single
slow and flat down leg stump, Hodge slogs and misses, the ball runs off his pads, Saha and Hodge set off, a good throw comes in but Hodge turns and dives in time
this absolutely rubbish over has sealed it! Balaji again gives up a loopy, juicy slow full toss and Saha says thank you very much, slogging it over midwicket for four
nearly a yorker finally, but Hodge makes room and bunts the ball down to long-on, Bailey collects and throws it back, Saha wanted one more but Hodge says nope
What. A. Player. I'm serious, this is the ice man cometh! Balaji slots it in the zone and Hodge goes straight, and very straight, into the sightscreen for six more
another stray ball down the pads, basically the attempted yorker gone wrong, Saha only gets one with his big swing because its an inside edge out to deep midwicket
full toss on the pads, swung out to Dhoni at deep square leg on the bounce, should have gone for six but
super, super, super dooper and what nerves! Balaji hits a length, Hodge doesn't flinch, clears the front leg again and drills that over long-off for maximum
strives for the yorker, too full and Hodge drives it to long-off
he's doing it! Albie strays down the leg stump and Hodge swings it over deep backward square leg, great placement because there is no one out there
best part of the ground and thats Hodge's half-century! Clears the front leg and hammers the length ball back over Albie's head, no stopping that one
full on middle and off, now Saha goes hard down to Bailey at long-off
fuller ball, Hodge clears the front leg and drills it down to long-off
length ball, slogged over midwicket, lands safely, Oram runs across from long-on, slides, fumbles, and keeps them to two

bad ball, very full and wide outside leg stump, it brushes the thinnest part of the bat and Patel does well to dive and get a hand on it to save it from finding the ropes, but the batsmen steal one more for the fumble
full outside off stump and he drives past extra cover out to Raina
another slower ball, fuller, he chips it in the air over mid-on safely
super shot, amazing! Saha plants the front foot across and slogs the length ball with excellent timing and placing, it was the slower ball and he dumped it over midwicket
much better delivery, slower one, on a length, Saha checks the shot and nearly plays the ball back to Balaji but it lands well short of him
terrible ball from Balaji, a full toss outside leg stump and Saha just needs to get some bat on it and thats four well wide of a tumbling Patel behind the stumps
tosses it up on off stump, Saha shuffles and flicks out to Badri
quicker delivery, just a bit too short and Hodge pulls past square
flat on middle and leg and Saha paddles it fine for a single
tossed up on the stumps and pushes the ball to the fielder and scampers

another one goes and Chennai are taking hold of the chase! Its a slider, quicker one, raps the pads as Hodge tries to turn it fine, Hussey sees the ball running off the pads toward point and sets off but then turns back as the single was just not on, Murali runs back and collects a good throw and finds Hussey just short of his mark, Kolkata really are slipping now
starts off with one outside off stump, Hodge drives past extra cover
low full toss on the stumps, Hussey bunts it back past the stumps and Hodge and calls for two immediately, gets it with some hard running
thats too short and wide, Hodge gets tall and slaps it past cover for one
well done Balaji, sees Hodge coming out and keeps it slower and fuller and straighter into the blockhole and Hodge has to adjust to jam it back to the bowler
full down leg stump again and Hodge glances it down to fine leg
pitches it up outside off stump and Hussey gets off the mark with an uppish drive through extra cover
full down the pads and thats clipped for a single down to fine leg

oh what do we have here? McCullum goes for a slog to a flat one just outside off stump and misses out, the ball scoots under the bat and somehow skims the off stump, they refer it after a thought as there's some doubt as to whether Dhoni uprooted the bails, but on close speculation it is evident that the ball dislodged the bail before Dhoni did, so McCullum has to go after a rollicking effort that has kept Kolkata in the hunt
slows it up and lands it on off stump, nudged just wide of point for two
flat on middle and leg, worked right to the fielder this time
flat on the pads, tucked past square leg, Dhoni ran after it and threw it back, misses the stumps, Badrinath was backing up and fumbles but does well
down he skips, connecting on the full to drive it over long-on for six
pushes it through flat on middle and off, he pushes to cover for one
slogs and gets an inside edge past square, Badri fields on the rope
quicker ball, flat outside off, Hodge waits and cuts right to cover

slower ball, tossed up just outside off, Hodge slog sweeps with a bit of an inside edge but picks the gap behind square leg, Balaji runs up from fine leg and Badrinath runs across from deep midwicket, slides, stops the ball but his back foot touches the rope as he palms the ball over to Balaji
hops to outside off stump and nudges the ball wide of midwicket
deja vu! He cuts again and this time Oram does a better effort to run across and slide to his left to cut the ball off
a tad too short, he makes room and cuts from on top of off stump, finds the gap and gives Oram some room down at third man
short again outside off and he gets back to perforate the off-side gap
short and he pulls hard over midwicket, Raina does the fielding

oh no thats a mess out at long-on from Oram, and what will that drop cost? Jakati tosses it up, McCullum slogs from the crease but doesn't time it, Oram backpedals and jumps up, gets a touch, but palms it over the ropes, he should have stayed back to begin with
short now and he paddle-pulls out to Raina at deep midwicket
takes a step down, Jakati slows the pace and Hodge defends
full and flat on leg stump, tucked past midwicket with ease
back to a shorter length and no turn, Hodge drives off the back foot
deft shot, just waits for the turn and opens the face, running the ball off the face of the bat past Dhoni and well wide of short third man
too wide this time so Hodge steers it behind point for a couple
straighter ball, still on a length, McCullum pushes to mid-on
tight line, just back of a length, gets tall and punches right to cover
flat on middle and off, he gets back and works the ball away
really good bowling, flat on middle and leg and Hodge defends
quicker and flatter to press Hodge onto the back foot, defending it back
better stuff, flighted up on a length just outside off stump to commit McCullum onto the front foot, he adjusts and runs it away for an easy single
bad ball, short and wide and cut past cover, Balaji cannot get there
flatter ball turns down the pads and McCullum doesn't time it well
tosses it up outside off, very full, McCullum pushes straight to cover
skips down, gets under the length ball, and goes high and handsome for a straight six, rousing end to the over and Hodge understand the situation now
moves across his stumps to sweep one, misses, the ball hits him on the front pad and they all go up, the umpire reckons Hodge did too much to get across
slower ball, arm ball, tossed up, McCullum drives to extra cover
better ball, angling into McCullum, who turns it wide of midwicket for two, Hodge pushes him for the second because he sees the man on the ropes is Balaji
flatter, shorter, quicker and McCullum miscues the pull shot but the ball skims his pads and runs away to the boundary for leg byes
smart batting from Hodge, just skips out and lofts the ball over mid-on to get his captain back on strike
well bowled, Murali! Tosses it through quicker, drifts on and McCullum nearly edges it, so Murali has done really well in his second over after McCullum raised his fifty inside the Powerplay
flatter ball, shorter too, forces him onto the back foot, turned to Raina
pitches on leg and turns down, he shuffles and turns it right to midwicket
beaten in the flight as he comes out, so pads the ball back to Murali
thats well played! Murali tosses it up, McCullum waits on the front foot and reads the one that goes on with the arm, as the ball goes by he opens the face excellently
flat ball from around the stumps, lands just around off stump, McCullum presses forward and plays the ball to the off side
flatter ball, full and wide, Hodge goes for the cut and misses

some turn there from back of a length, he goes back and is nearly beaten, ends up pushing the ball to cover and calls for the single, he does well to stick his bat out and just beats a terrific direct hit from Raina, good fielding and good running in the end
wider ball, gets room to free his arms and cuts past backward point
quicker ball, pitches on the stumps and he pushes to cover
flatter ball on the pads and easily turned around the corner for one
tossed up on off stump, Hodge pushes to cover and sets off
oh this is carnage! Tyagi has lost the plot! Serves up a rank full toss down leg stump and McCullum swivels and pulls it flat over fine leg for half a dozen and his half-century
thats four in four! McCullum raises Kolkata's 50 by getting to the pitch of a full ball and slamming it on the rise over extra cover
make it a hat-trick! Short ball, spotted, and drilled over midwicket
bad bowling this, full ball on the pads and McCullum only has to get a wee bit of bat on it as he shuffles across, the result is a boundary to fine leg
fuller and he goes in the air just over cover-point, well struck shot
short of a length, McCullum hops back and pushes to Tyagi
fizzes it up on leg stump, Hodge defends and plays out the maiden over
big appeal to one that lands outside leg stump and hits the front pad, Murali and Dhoni were very enthusiastic but that wasn't going to be give out

not sure what he's upto! Ganguly makes room to cut, the ball pitches shorter and turns away, Ganguly again cannot middle the ball and inside-edges onto the base of leg stump ... the bail pops up ... Dhoni immediately realises before anyone else, in fact Ganguly was setting off for a bye but then looks back and sees the horror before him
flatter ball on a length, turns away from outside leg, Ganguly defends
spins down and runs off the pads as he attempts to glance it fine
flat from around the stumps, pitches well outside leg, McCullum blocks
fuller ball outside off stump, same result ... just cant get bat on ball
Dada, ki hochche? Again he makes room, flashes and misses
takes a step down, makes some room, shuts his eyes and pulls a short ball and gets a thin inside edge that drops safely in front of Dhoni behind the stumps
hits a far better length this time and draws a driven single to extra cover
tries to bounce McCullum but he pulls excellently in front of square

good length just outside off stump, Ganguly defends to the off side and sets off, its Jakati this time who collects and has a throw, misses, Ganguly again doesn't ground the bat and had the fielder found his mark Dada was a goner
timber but it won't matter a jot! Albie hits back with a near yorker on the stumps, McCullum makes room and drives, ball flattens middle stump but it won't hurt Kolkata
aye, whats he up to? First he oversteps, then he offers McCullum a gift-wrapped full ball on the pads, which is rightfully clipped over square leg for four ... free hit time
change of pace, hits a good length, McCullum defends to cover
makes room, Albie follows him with the attempted yorker but McCullum punches it off the middle back down the ground and beats mid-off for four more
thats a sweet shot! McCullum gives himself room and goes inside out,  plenty of bottom hand involved too, and clears extra cover for a flat six inches over the ropes
makes room and flashes hard at a shorter ball but still no timing, the result is an inside edge chopped in front of cover
attempted yorker outside off stump, swings back and Ganguly gently pushes it toward cover
good ball, back of a length on the dime and McCullum just defends
straighter ball and he brushes it off the pads down to fine leg
short ball but Ganguly just cannot time anything, gets back to pull and inside-edges it off the toe end of the bat and Tyagi does the fielding
this one's full and wide, Ganguly backs away and misses out

short of a length on middle and leg, a nervous Ganguly is hurried onto the back foot and pushes the ball to cover, looks to get off strike but McCullum duly waves him back as Bailey picks up the ball and hits the stumps
gets back and mistimes a defensive to a length ball outside off stump
back of a length and angling in, McCullum tucks it straight to midwicket
juicy half-volley on the pads and he clips that superbly past square leg
edged and just over Raina at slip! Albie persists with that fuller length and gets some swing, McCullum flashes loosely away from the body and the outside edge evades slip
pitched up and McCullum drives straight to extra cover
hits a good length just outside off stump, Ganguly pushes gently and runs hard, Murali is deep at mid-off and just misses the stumps, had he hit Ganguly was gone because he dropped his bat
pitches it up and McCullum presses at it, nudging it wide of gully
